stemMd: Which substance is made of molecules rather than an extended ionic lattice in its ordinary pure solid form?
explanationMd: Solid carbon dioxide consists of discrete CO₂ molecules held together by intermolecular forces. The other choices are ionic compounds organized as extended arrays of cations and anions. Molecular composition differs from a formula unit in a lattice.

distractorRationale.e: It forms an ionic lattice of sodium and chloride ions.
distractorRationale.a: It is an ionic solid with magnesium and oxide ions.
